levels.L0: QUICK: seconds-scale immediate checks on changed files
levels.L1: FOCUSED: module/API-scoped host patterns + dev-rom + 1-2 dev integrations (~2 min)
levels.L2: IMPACT: related host files + related direct scripts + check (~5 min)
levels.L3: FULL: current required regression, unconditional (local L3 + Required CI)
levels.L4: EXTENDED: CI-outside opt-in only (reference info, never a Required substitute)

ci_classes.required-ci: Test executes in a workflow job backing one of the 6 Required Checks.
ci_classes.ci-nonrequired: Test executes in CI (every PR or schedule) but backs no Required Check.
ci_classes.ci-outside-optin: A make target exists but no workflow invokes it; explicit local opt-in only.
ci_classes.push-only: Workflow runs only on push to main / schedule / dispatch, never on PRs.
